narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms along and behind a cold front produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central Virginia.
ev: Water rescue occurred at 1200 Block of West Hundred Road. One lane of west bound Route 10 was partially closed due to water on roadway.
lsr: WATER RESCUE AT 1200 BLOCK OF WEST HUNDRED ROAD. 1 LANE OF WEST BOUND VA-10 PARTIALLY CLOSED DUE TO WATER ON ROADWAY.
